changes: General ECI contract applies to every client, without detecting private controls or a specific add-on.
eci.h forwards to the public SDK header, with canonical ECI parameter, callback, language and dictionary names.
Callback 0 retries the same PCM or index after 30 ms; 2 aborts; Stop interrupts retry. Index is published after each callback attempt, matching static reference analysis.
Standard program/error state accumulates separately from the private last-synthesis diagnostic. Add four SDK error/reentry exports.
SDK Reset always restores global standard defaults, editable presets, input and renderer histories. Host routing, owned dictionary sets and the independent acoustic profile remain preserved.

Add nine dictionary search/enumeration/edit/save exports using the same native dictionary tables as speech; transactional updates, source-independent owned data, per-language activation and narrow/UTF-16 strings.
InsertIndex accepts every signed 32-bit payload; failed AddText preserves already accepted input. Reentrant Delete and Synchronize report ECI error without destroying the active handle.
DSP and acoustic source files unchanged from dev8; no claim to resolve audible crackling, missing brilliant voiced body or sporadic stuttering.

checks.canonical_sdk_header: C11 Linux and Windows x64, C++17 Linux; -Wall -Wextra -Werror passed
checks.pcm_identity_coverage: German/US English, male/female, all seven rates, profiles A/B; normal processed callbacks; RAM only
checks.inline_tags: 75 fragmentation/index plus 21 exact tag/slider speed cases and pause/voice/mode/malformed-input checks passed
checks.native_error_recovery: passed: rejected utterance does not discard later jobs
checks.nvda_driver_en: 24 initial-language/schema cases plus selectable x64 FIFO/index/cancel/close passed
checks.nvda_driver_de: 24 initial-language/schema cases plus selectable x64 FIFO/index/cancel/close passed
checks.windows_x64_cross_build: passed; PE ABI 47 exports, only kernel32/msvcrt/user32 imports

reference.method: static export and instruction inspection; no Windows runtime execution of original DLL

limits: Windows runtime CI for dev9 is separate and must finish before claiming Windows runtime validation.
No NVDA/Windows-on-ARM listening, latency or stutter measurement on the user device.
Crackling, voiced-body/Richness quality and sporadic high-rate stuttering remain open; this build deliberately preserves dev8 DSP.

43 original export names do not establish full behavioral parity. 17 reference exports remain absent; synthesis is synchronous, fragment parameter snapshots, TextMode 2/3, NumberMode, phoneme indices and device/file/filter output remain incomplete.
MainDictExt and extra Asian legacy code-set modes are not implemented; plain dictionary volumes return part of speech 0.
Reset preserves host routing unlike the old device reset; this difference is explicit for every client.
Legacy UTF-16 dictionary conversion on Android is not validated; the existing JNI UTF-8 path remains unchanged.
